Putin claims election win endorses Ukraine war

Russian President Vladimir Putin has stated that his election victory serves as an endorsement of his ongoing war in Ukraine. The Daily Telegraph reported that the President has been a victim of Putin's propaganda war and that Russia is now fighting back. The Wall Street Journal noted that Putin casts the election result as an endorsement of his war.
